Principles.Principle: Transfer mathematical, biophysical, neurological, and ecological principles from peer-reviewed biology and A-Life literature, while engineering 100% original parametric morphologies, body silhouettes, connectomes, shaders, and source code. Zero copied meshes, sprites, weight dumps, or repositories.

Principle.name: Compensated FP64 First-Law Closure & Second-Law Sink

Principles.Principle: Conserve mass and enthalpy across all 11 pools (`E_patch..E_heat_phys + E_diss_num`) in IEEE `FP64` with Kahan-Neumaier compensation (`|ΔE| / (E_0 + E_in,cum) < 1e-12`; never `Q16.16`). Enforce Second-Law irreversibility (`0` heat-to-ATP backflow) and book XPBD numerical damping explicitly (`ΔE_diss_num ≥ -1e-15`).

Every declared organ, neural sub-circuit, soft hydrostatic chamber, neuromodulator, and transducer must causally alter internal state and downstream behavior within its active ecological regime. Display-only variables, dead matrices, and scripted animations fail conformance.

Principle.name: Seed Firewall, Domain-Isolated PRNG & Two-Tier Reproducibility

Principles.Principle: Separate `Practice (100–999)`, `Tuning (2000–2999)`, and `Locked Held-Out Test (≥5000, burn-on-fail)` seeds. Key `Philox4x32-10` counters by `(ver, seed, domain, entity_id, organ_id, tick, purpose, draw_idx)` with `WORLD_EXOG` isolated from `ENTITY_INT`. Tier-1 CPU/WASM uses core-shipped `exp_det`/`log_det` and `.alifebin` snapshots for bit-exact SHA-256 hashes; Tier-2 GPU/surrogate bulk mode verifies preregistered observable distribution parity.

Principle.name: Soft Embodied Allostasis, Chemoton Chemistry & Real Mortality

Principles.Principle: Ground survival in deformable XPBD hydrostatic boundaries (`|ΔV|/V_0 < 1%`), Gánti's 3-cycle Chemoton (`A`, membrane `T`, template polymer `pV_n`), Michaelis-Menten saturation, 3-phase fasting, clotting/regeneration, and irreversible death returning carcass mass to dome detritus.

Principle.name: Controlled Multi-Arm Causal & FWER Statistical Proof

Principles.Principle: Evaluate claims across `1. Intact`, `2. Passive Soft-Body (0-Brain)`, `3. Shuffled Stream`, `4. Targeted Lesion`, plus `Size-Matched Sham Lesion` (for ablations) and `Competent Simple Baseline` (for complex substrates). Use power-sized paired locked seeds (`N ≥ 24` large effects; `N = 64–120` moderate effects), exact paired Wilcoxon/sign-flip tests with **Holm-Bonferroni FWER (`α ≤ 0.05`)**, within-pair dominance `δ_pair ≥ 0.33`, and one-sided non-inferiority (`LCB_95% > -Δ_NI`) on prior floors.

Principle.name: Neutral Operational Framing & Static/Mutant Anti-LARP Guard

Principles.Principle: Treat `Butlin-14`, `F1–F10`, and forked-snapshot `PCI*` strictly as operational computational-dynamics indicators—never metaphysical claims of subjective sentience. Enforce AST/symbol-import oracle bans and reject all 5 negative mutants (`Leaky-2e-11, Cosmetic, Oracle, Frozen, Shuffled`).

Grow bodies and brains from yolk-funded founder cells via GRN cleavage, differential adhesion, apoptosis, and size-proportional juvenile sleep pruning; preserve learned aversions across holometabolous metamorphosis inside an `O(N_pop + C_pairs)` closed trophic dome.

In Tier-1 canonical runs, camera pose, open UI tabs, exports, and the Frame-Time Governor adjust **render & lossy UI decimation ONLY**—never physics meshes, ray counts, or `WSE` timing (`UI-open hash == headless hash`). Scope zero-copy strictly to Sim-Worker ↔ UI-Worker `SharedArrayBuffer` (`SeqLock` 3-retry bound + double-buffer fallback).

Principle.name: Hardware Frugality, Explicit Arena Accounting & Multirate Clocks

Principles.Principle: Use flat `SoA` `TypedArray` arenas (`0` post-warmup heap allocations across `10,000` ticks), tiled sparse `CSR` / 32-synapse packed `int4`/`b1.58` blocks with separate plasticity/queue budgets, the `5-Gear Deterministic Multirate Scheduler`, `0 ≤ Q ≤ 10` qubit caps, and contiguous hysteresis Governor bands.

ComplexityLegend.Symbol: Neural units / compartments per creature brain (reference Tier-W focal = 50,000; Tier-L laptop = 8,192).
Directed stored synaptic edges per creature brain (reference focal = 10^8 at density ρ = 4.0%; Tier-L = 500,000).
Active spiking fraction per Gear-1 (5 ms) step; biological sparse regime k ≈ 0.01–0.04 (2–8 Hz mean firing rate).
Active organisms in dome/biosphere; broad-phase spatial hash is O(N_pop + C_pairs), where C_pairs = local candidate contacts.
Soft-body viscoelastic mesh vertices per organism (fixed per experiment in Tier-1 canonical runs: e.g. 24, 32, or 64).
Active sensory rays / plume sample probes per organism step; B_bands = cochlear / lateral-line spectral filter bands.
Latent world-model, working-memory, or VSA hypervector dimension (typically 128–4,096).
M_pat = stored Modern Hopfield episodic patterns; M_mod = parallel specialist modules competing for workspace ignition.
G_sp = spline intervals per KAN edge; G_plan = nodes in internal Riemannian planning graph.
Bounded inner solver iterations per step (e.g., XPBD constraint sweeps K=4..8, implicit chemistry Newton steps K=2..4).
Coherent qubits in optional internal quantum register; integer-clamped 0 ≤ Q ≤ 10 (statevector = 2^(Q+4) bytes ≤ 16 KiB).

ThermodynamicContract.Representation: IEEE-754 FP64 with Kahan-Neumaier compensated summation (or int64 1-microjoule integer quanta); NEVER Q16.16 fixed-point.
ThermodynamicContract.SecondLawRule: Heat sinks (E_heat_phys, E_diss_num) are strictly one-way irreversible sinks (dE_heat_phys/dt ≥ 0, zero back-conversion to E_atp, E_stores, or mechanical work; ΔE_diss_num < -1e-15 triggers anti-free-energy fault).

Pools.Pool: Primary producer / substrate chemical enthalpy standing stock (kJ)
Unabsorbed chyme enthalpy inside organism digestive lumen (kJ)
Circulating glucose, free fatty acids, amino acids & beta-HB ketones (kJ)
Hepatic glycogen + adipose triacylglycerol reserve pools (kJ)
Immediate high-energy phosphate currency gating spikes, pumps & motors (kJ)
Macroscopic translational & rotational soft-body kinetic energy (kJ)
Reversible XPBD viscoelastic membrane & tendon strain potential energy (kJ)
Excreted urea/feces + post-mortem carcass labile organic pools (kJ)
Irreversible metabolic, frictional & spike-dissipation thermal sink (kJ; monotone non-decreasing)
Explicit XPBD / implicit-integrator numerical damping sink (kJ; must satisfy ΔE_diss_num ≥ -1e-15 per step)

Dimension.name: Computational
Dimension.tagline: What Math, Precision Contracts & Information Transformations Execute Inside the Entity
Dimension.hwRule: Use tiled sparse CSR O(k·E_syn) + 32-synapse packed blocks; clamp coherent quantum registers to integer 0 ≤ Q ≤ 10.

EightDimensions.Dimension: In Soft A-Life & wet biology, computation spans sparse spiking events, adaptive liquid conductances, reaction-diffusion PDEs, apical calcium XOR plateaus, and passive viscoelastic strain fields—each governed by an explicit storage/accumulator/rounding contract.

Dimension.name: Operational
Dimension.tagline: How the Simulation Schedules, Allocates, Streams & Stays Deterministic on Real Silicon
Dimension.hwRule: Zero allocations & zero BigInt conversions in tick(); verify crossOriginIsolated before enabling SharedArrayBuffer.

EightDimensions.Dimension: Coupling deformable bodies, spiking cortices, and ecosystems stalls CPUs/GPUs if everything steps at 0.5 ms in GC-allocated objects. Operational engineering enforces multirate clocks, flat SoA arenas, deterministic math, and render-only frame governance.

Dimension.name: Functional
Dimension.tagline: What Adaptive Viability Problem Each Mechanism Solves ('Why It Pays Its ATP Rent')
Dimension.hwRule: Every module must beat Passive-Body, Shuffled, Targeted-Lesion, and Size-Matched Sham-Lesion controls on locked seeds.

EightDimensions.Dimension: Biological organs persist because they solve concrete survival, homeostatic, or reproductive problems under energetic scarcity. Functional contracts define input-to-consequence lift independent of substrate, supporting degeneracy.

Dimension.name: Systems
Dimension.tagline: Closed-Loop Cybernetics, First/Second-Law Conservation & Push-Pull Organ Coupling
Dimension.hwRule: Enforce single-writer double-buffered state updates (`prev -> next`) and explicit cross-gear flux accumulators.

EightDimensions.Dimension: A living creature is not a feedforward `sense -> think -> act` pipe; it is a closed thermodynamic knot where visceral chemistry modulates neural gain, action reshapes resource patches, and heat exits one-way under First- and Second-Law constraints.

Dimension.name: Design
Dimension.tagline: Parametric Bauplan Geometry, Compliance Gradients, Connectome Wiring & Protection Rings
Dimension.hwRule: Fix soft-mesh vertex count per experiment in Tier-1 canonical mode; reserve multi-fidelity mesh swapping for Tier-2 crowds.

EightDimensions.Dimension: Design governs the creature's 100% original physical bauplan, viscoelastic compliance distribution, active sensor geometry, 3D wiring cost, and write-protection rings—making mechanical and metabolic trade-offs evolvable.

Dimension.name: Orders
Dimension.tagline: Orthogonal Spatial Scales (O0–O7) × Cybernetic Control Orders (0th–4th Order)
Dimension.hwRule: Coarsen integration rate and aggregate spatial representations at higher O-levels so host step time stays bounded.

EightDimensions.Dimension: Separating physical spatial scale (ions to biospheres) from cybernetic control depth (passive compliance to lineage evolution) eliminates 'Orders' ambiguity and assigns every variable a clear clock gear and state width.

Dimension.name: Processes
Dimension.tagline: Continuous & Event-Driven Biophysical Fluxes Unfolding Across Time
Dimension.hwRule: Use exact exponential-Euler for linear decay and bounded implicit backward-Euler/TR-BDF2 for stiff nonlinear chemistry.

EightDimensions.Dimension: Living matter is never static at rest: ion pumps counter osmotic leak, metabolic intermediates turn over, eligibility traces decay, adenosine accumulates, and soil detritus mineralizes continuously.

Dimension.name: Stages
Dimension.tagline: Discrete Phase Regimes Across Ontogeny, Arousal/Sleep, Fasting & Verification Gates
Dimension.hwRule: Block promotion to Stage k+1 until Stage k passes 100% of thermodynamic, memory-arena, and causal-control gates.

EightDimensions.Dimension: Continuous biological processes reorganize across sharp regime transitions—zygote hatching, critical-period closure, pupal metamorphosis, NREM/REM flips, cryptobiotic vitrification, and strict CI promotion gates.

Layout.label: 1. Naive Heap-Object Graph ({w, pre, post, delay, masks})
Layout.verdict: Pointer chasing + GC thrash; 800 GB @ 10¹⁰ syn OOMs all nodes

Layout.label: 2. Dense FP32 Weight Matrix (Float32Array N² = 50K²)
Layout.verdict: 96% zeros; 1.00 TB @ 100×50K & 8.59 GB even on Tier-L 32×8K!

Layout.label: 3. Uncompressed Sparse CSR (FP32 4B + uint32 4B + delay 1B + 2b mask)
Layout.verdict: 92.5 GB @ 10¹⁰ syn (Workstation RAM); 148 MB on Tier-L 32×500K

Layout.label: 4. Tiled Sparse CSR (FP16 2B + tile-uint16 2B + delay 1B + 2b mask)
Layout.verdict: 52.5 GB @ 10¹⁰ syn (Tier-W 64–128 GB); 84.0 MB on Tier-L Laptop

Layout.label: 5. 32-Synapse Block-Sparse int8 (32B w + 2B scale + 2B tile + 8B mask + 2B dly)
Layout.verdict: 14.38 GB @ 10¹⁰ syn (fits 24 GB dGPU); 23.0 MB on Tier-L Laptop

Layout.label: 6. 32-Synapse Packed int4 Block (16B w + 2B FP16 scale + 2B tile + 8B 2b-masks)
Layout.verdict: 8.75 GB @ 10¹⁰ syn (fits 16–24 GB VRAM); 14.0 MB on Tier-L Laptop

Layout.label: 7. 32-Synapse Packed Ternary b1.58 Block (7B 5-trit/B + 2B scale + 2B tile + 8B masks)
Layout.verdict: 5.94 GB weights @ 10¹⁰ syn (Tier-D/W GPU); 9.5 MB on Tier-L Laptop!

Content-selective input gates decide which sensory surprises write into persistent recurrent state.

Exponential pattern capacity retrieving full episodes from `≥ 50%` occluded cues in 1–3 settling steps.

Activates only `k_exp = 1..2` specialist spheres per step, decoupling capacity from per-tick FLOPs.

SIMD bitwise/XOR/permutation role-filler binding over `1,024–4,096d` bipolar/ternary vectors.
Asynchronous event queues touching outgoing edges strictly on threshold crossings.

ForensicItem.title: Rigid-Sphere Embodiment Gap
ForensicItem.Hazard: Modeling organisms as rigid circles/spheres eliminates compliant gripping, narrow-gap squeezing, peristalsis, and passive terrain damping.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Build 2D/3D XPBD viscoelastic membrane + `|ΔV|/V_0 < 1%` hydrostatic coelom (`SOFT01–SOFT10`).

ForensicItem.title: Missing Wet Autopoietic Core
ForensicItem.Hazard: Single scalar `energy` counters lack stoichiometric coupling between metabolism, membrane surface area, and template replication.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Implement Gánti Chemoton (`A`, lipid `T`, polymer `pV_n`) + Michaelis-Menten saturation (`SOFT21–SOFT25`).

ForensicItem.title: Missing Sensorimotor Forward Model
ForensicItem.Hazard: Without an internal efference-copy predictor, self-generated soft-body deformation triggers false external threat/obstacle reflexes.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Wire motor-to-sensory forward predictor (`AE-2`, `M073`) subtracting expected self-reafference.

ForensicItem.title: No Metamorphosis / Cell Sorting
ForensicItem.Hazard: Scalar mass growth omits embryonic cell sorting, apoptotic sculpting, and larval-to-adult body remodeling with memory survival.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Implement Steinberg adhesion, apoptosis, and Blackiston-assay pupal remodeling (`SOFT32–35`, `M084`).

ForensicItem.title: Missing Sham & Passive Controls
ForensicItem.Hazard: Comparing Intact only against uncalibrated cuts conflates passive body physics and random damage size with true circuit function.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Require 4 core arms + `Size-Matched Sham Lesion` + `Competent Simple Baseline` (`P6`).

ForensicItem.title: Unseparated Weight vs Plasticity RAM
ForensicItem.Hazard: Counting only packed weight bits hides eligibility queues, consolidation cascades, masks, neuron states, and GPU staging buffers.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Enforce full-process memory inventory separating packed weights from bounded `+0.40 B/syn` plasticity rings (`ALF-004`).

ForensicItem.title: SharedArrayBuffer Origin Isolation
ForensicItem.Hazard: Browsers disable `SharedArrayBuffer` unless top-level `COOP: same-origin` + `COEP: require-corp` headers establish `crossOriginIsolated`.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Assert `self.crossOriginIsolated === true` at boot (`HW14`); fall back cleanly to double-buffered `postMessage` transfer.

ForensicItem.title: Mobile/Laptop Thermal Throttling
ForensicItem.Hazard: Sustained SIMD/WebGPU bursts push mobile silicon past 90°C, dropping host clocks and desynchronizing wall-clock assumptions.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Decouple integer `sim_tick` from `wall_time`; drive contiguous Frame-Time Governor (`HW21`) via EMA `ms/frame`.

ForensicItem.title: Spreadsheet 1,048,576-Row Ceiling
ForensicItem.Hazard: Dumping raw spike rasters or synapse tables directly into `.xlsx`/`.xls` crashes writers or silently truncates past `1,048,576` rows.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Route full tensors to `Parquet`/`HDF5`; auto-shard `.xls`/`.xlsx` into `≤ 500K`-row summary sheets + manifests.

ForensicItem.title: Multi-Artifact Specification Drift
ForensicItem.Hazard: Editing PDFs, CSVs, JSON, and workbooks by hand causes IDs, byte totals, and Cube cells to diverge across files.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Generate all 9 output formats (`PDF, JSON, MD, XML, TXT, YAML, HTML, CSV, XLS`) from one canonical v3.0 schema + audit script.

ForensicItem.title: Lossy UI Ring vs Lossless Audit
ForensicItem.Hazard: Sharing one circular buffer between a 60 Hz UI sparkline and scientific benchmark logging drops audit events under burst load.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Separate overwrite-allowed UI telemetry rings (with explicit `gap_count`) from backpressure-safe lossless Export/Audit streams.

ForensicItem.title: Broken Git Worktree Provenance
ForensicItem.Hazard: Copied directories containing broken `.git` pointer files lack object stores, invalidating commit SHA provenance in test manifests.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Gate Stage 0 (`M003`, `GATE-01`) on `git rev-parse --verify HEAD` + clean working-tree manifest hash.

ForensicItem.title: Continuum FEM Fidelity vs Evo Speed
ForensicItem.Hazard: High-element 3D continuum FEM (`~50 ms/step`) precludes multi-generation evolutionary sweeps on single workstations.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ruling: Evolve on fixed-mesh XPBD hydrostats (`0.5 ms` Gear 0); validate selected genotypes in high-resolution continuum.

ForensicItem.title: Cross-OS Bit-Exactness vs GPU Speed
ForensicItem.Hazard: Parallel WebGPU/CUDA float reductions are non-associative, preventing bit-identical hashes against sequential CPU code.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ruling: Tier-1 CPU/WASM canonical mode enforces bit-exact hashes; Tier-2 GPU bulk mode verifies preregistered observable tolerances.

ForensicItem.title: Open-Ended Speciation vs Fixed Floors
ForensicItem.Hazard: Locomotor foraging floors unfairly penalize lineages evolving into sessile filter-feeders, ambushers, or decomposers.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ruling: Enforce universal First-Law + autopoietic viability globally; score behavioral competence per MAP-Elites guild cell.

ForensicItem.title: Compact Indirect GRN vs Mutational Lethality
ForensicItem.Hazard: Indirect developmental GRN/NCA encodings compress genomes dramatically but risk catastrophic embryonic instability under point mutation.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ruling: Canalize embryogenesis via bioelectric polarity clamping (`SOFT37`) and homeostatic `iSTDP`/synaptic scaling (`M045`).

ForensicItem.title: Per-Agent Retina/Cochlea vs Crowd Scale
ForensicItem.Hazard: Full 2D RGBD retinas for 500 crowd organisms saturate integrated GPU bandwidth, yet changing rays alters Tier-1 trajectory hashes.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ruling: Keep sensor config fixed for all agents in Tier-1 canonical runs; enable salience-scheduled crowd LOD strictly in Tier-2.

ForensicItem.title: Live Hardware Sensors vs Repeatability
ForensicItem.Hazard: Live webcam/microphone/IMU inputs provide genuine open-world entropy but cannot repeat deterministically across CI runs.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ruling: Explore live in Practice mode while recording immutable timestamped `.sensorlog` streams replayed bit-exactly in Test gates.

ForensicItem.title: 24 GB/s Naive Live Synapse Streaming
ForensicItem.Hazard: Streaming `10^8 × 4 B × 60 Hz = 24 GB/s` across threads violates memory-bus budgets and stalls simulation workers.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Corrected: Stream `O(1)` statistical sketches (`≤ 32 KB/fr`) globally; pull subgraph slices on demand (`2 Hz`) for inspected organs.

ForensicItem.title: Full 825-Suite Per Online WSE Edit
ForensicItem.Hazard: Running full held-out benchmark suites on every millisecond in-life `WSE` plasticity edit freezes runtime execution.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Corrected: 3-Tier WSE Gate—Tier-0 `O(1)` induced-norm `‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99` + ATP check online, Tier-1 sleep shadow rollout, Tier-2 promotion.

ForensicItem.title: Underpowered & Mislabeled FDR Stats
ForensicItem.Hazard: Conflating Holm-Bonferroni FWER with FDR `q`-values or claiming `N=16` powers 100-item medium-effect families invites false claims.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Corrected: Exact paired Wilcoxon/sign-flip + **Holm-Bonferroni FWER (`α ≤ 0.05`)**, power-sized `N` (`24..120`), `δ_pair`, and `LCB_95% > -Δ_NI`.

ForensicItem.title: Z-Blind 2D Cube Compatibility
ForensicItem.Hazard: Scoring `Model × Precision` while ignoring `Geometry Z` misses hyperbolic (`Z4`), attractor (`Z5`), and steerable (`Z6`) low-bit failures.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Corrected: Full 3-axis `evaluateCubeCell(X, Y, Z)` with grayscale-safe `[OK] / [OVER] / [ADAPT] / [EXCL]` synced across PDF & CSV/XLS.

ForensicItem.title: Shared PRNG & World-Entity Coupling
ForensicItem.Hazard: Drawing random numbers sequentially or failing to isolate world weather from creature organs scrambles trajectories upon ablation.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Corrected: `Philox4x32-10` keyed by `(ver, seed, domain, entity, organ, tick, purpose, idx)` isolating `WORLD_EXOG` from `ENTITY_INT`.

ForensicItem.title: Circular Parameter Count & Exact-Φ Claims
ForensicItem.Hazard: Equating parameter count with competence or claiming exact `O(2^N)` IIT `Φ` on large brains is scientifically invalid.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Corrected: Require forked-snapshot perturbational `PCI*` (`F2`), `C-NC` causal divergence, and Competent Simple Baselines.

ForensicItem.title: Cross-OS libm Transcendental ULP Drift
ForensicItem.Hazard: Host `Math.exp`/`Math.log`/`Math.tanh` implementations vary by `1–2 ULP` across OS/browser engines, breaking bit-exact hashes.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Ship core-owned versioned deterministic minimax/LUT `exp_det`, `log_det`, `pow_det`, and `tanh_det` in Tier-1 runtime.

ForensicItem.title: Explicit Euler Soft-Spring Explosion & Free Energy
ForensicItem.Hazard: Explicit Euler explodes on stiff membranes, while unmonitored XPBD constraint projections can inject or dissipate unbooked energy.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Use XPBD (`α̃ = α/dt²`) + book positive solver damping to `E_diss_num ≥ 0` and fault on `ΔE_diss_num < -1e-15`.

ForensicItem.title: FP32 Small-Addend Absorption in Ledger
ForensicItem.Hazard: Adding `1e-6 kJ` spike heat to a `1e5 kJ` dome heat accumulator in `FP32` (`24` mantissa bits) rounds the increment completely to `0`.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Accumulate all 11 enthalpy/mass pools in `FP64` with Kahan-Neumaier compensation (`|ΔE|/(E0+Ein) < 1e-12`).

ForensicItem.title: JS 32-Bit Shift Wraparound (`1 << 32 === 1`)
ForensicItem.Hazard: In JS/C-style 32-bit shifts, `1 << Q` masks `Q & 31` (`Q=32` allocates 2 floats instead of guarding, while `Q=30` overflows signed int32!).
ForensicItem.Resolution: Validate `Number.isInteger(Q) && Q >= 0 && Q <= 10` first, then allocate `2 * (2 ** Q)` `Float64` values (`≤ 16 KiB`).

ForensicItem.title: Per-Tick Closures, BigInt Box & WASM Grow
ForensicItem.Hazard: Temporary closures, `BigInt` boxing in JS PRNGs, or dynamic WASM `memory.grow` inside `tick()` trigger latency spikes and view invalidation.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Pre-allocate fixed SoA arenas; use `Math.imul` 32-bit `Philox4x32-10`; assert `0` allocs & `0` page grows across `10,000` ticks.

ForensicItem.title: Lesion Toggle Resurrecting Pruned Wires
ForensicItem.Hazard: Restoring a reversible lesion by setting mask bits to `1` overwrites `0`s created by developmental or sleep pruning.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Maintain orthogonal `structuralMask` (ontogeny/sleep) and `lesionMask` (assay), applying `effectiveMask = structuralMask & lesionMask`.

ForensicItem.title: Epistemic Curiosity vs Starvation Urgency
ForensicItem.Hazard: Additive novelty bonuses overpower homeostatic error when fuel runs low, causing starving organisms to inspect noisy traps.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Multiplicative Urgency Gate: weight epistemic value by sigmoid survival margin `σ((TTC - TTC_crit)/τ)`.

ForensicItem.title: In-Life WSE Surgery vs Autonomic Survival
ForensicItem.Hazard: Self-editing operators optimizing short-horizon reward silence nociceptors, cardiac pacemakers, or metabolic accounting.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Hardware-enforced Protection Rings: `Ring-0` (`brainstem, nociception, ledger, harness`) uses frozen read-only views.

ForensicItem.title: Cuticle Armor Stiffening vs Squeeze/Speed
ForensicItem.Hazard: Inducible cuticle thickening shields against toxins/bites but raises bending energy, mass, and narrow-aperture failure.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Expose as regulated endocrine/catch-state trade-off (`SOFT04`) modulated by predator/toxin threat cues.

ForensicItem.title: Fast Hebbian LTP vs Recurrent Runaway
ForensicItem.Hazard: Positive Hebbian loops without rapid counterbalance saturate firing rates or collapse into epileptic synchrony.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Couple 3-factor LTP with fast inhibitory `iSTDP`, sliding BCM threshold, `‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99` guard, and NREM `SHY`.

ForensicItem.title: Exotic Field Senses vs Anti-LARP Physics
ForensicItem.Hazard: Simulated bioelectric or distant-sensing channels degenerate into zero-cost oracle cheats if unattenuated.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Mediate every exotic sense through inverse-distance noisy in-world fields with strict per-bit ATP debit and shuffle controls.

ForensicItem.title: Concurrent Multi-Organ State Write Races
ForensicItem.Hazard: Sleep flip-flop, HPA cortisol, and workspace writing shared `arousal` in arbitrary order produce order-dependent oscillations.
ForensicItem.Resolution: Single-writer variable ownership + canonical deterministic reducer over double-buffered `prevTick -> nextTick` state.
